purpose: Define a bounded temporary rendezvous record carrying discoverability/session-establishment metadata without becoming persistent identity or message storage.

topics.name: Hello Rendezvous Bootstrap Record
topics.purpose: Define a bounded temporary rendezvous record carrying discoverability/session-establishment metadata without becoming persistent identity or message storage.

semantics.record_rule: Each rendezvous record has a transient runtime/bootstrap identity.
semantics.peer_rule: Record references exact peer/service identities or discovery handles.
semantics.metadata_rule: Only metadata required for discovery/signaling/session establishment is stored.
semantics.ttl_rule: Record lifetime/TTL is explicit and finite.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Record is removed/expired after successful peer establishment, cancellation or timeout according to policy.
semantics.payload_rule: User/application message payload is not stored in the rendezvous record.
semantics.identity_rule: Rendezvous record identity is not a semantic user/device/service identity.

invariants.rule: Hello/Rendezvous performs peer discovery/bootstrap only; it never becomes application-payload owner, semantic peer identity, or authorization authority.

hard_gates.condition: record stores application message payload by default
record id becomes semantic peer identity
